verdict.rationale: Meilisearch clearly supports synonyms (docs-5) and customizable ranking rules including sort/exactness/proximity (docs-4,23,32), letting devs tune relevance broadly. However, explicit per-query pinning/boosting/hiding ('Dynamic Search Rules... Boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request') only appears on the pricing page (docs-15, docs-30), suggesting this curation capability may be a paid/Cloud-tier feature rather than a core self-hosted API capability, and no docs page details its configuration or API. missing for 10: dedicated docs/API reference for pin/boost/hide curation, confirmation it's available in open-source/self-hosted core (not just Cloud), and independent/hands-on evidence of it working.
